description: This script generates C++ code for OpenGL uniform type info tables, defining data structures and functions related to uniform types.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that generates the C++ code for uniform type info tables.

methods.name: gen_type_info
methods.description: Generates a string of uniform type info data for a given uniform type.

methods.name: gen_type_index_case
methods.description: Generates a switch case string for a uniform type index.

methods.name: get_component_type
methods.description: Determines the component type (e.g., GL_FLOAT, GL_INT) for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_texture_type
methods.description: Determines the texture type associated with a uniform type.

methods.name: get_transposed_type
methods.description: Determines the transposed matrix type for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_bool_type
methods.description: Determines the boolean type for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_sampler_format
methods.description: Determines the sampler format for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Gets the number of rows for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Gets the number of columns for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_components
methods.description: Calculates the total number of components for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_component_size
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the component type.

methods.name: get_internal_size
methods.description: Calculates internal size in bytes for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_external_size
methods.description: Calculates external size in bytes for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_is_sampler
methods.description: Checks if the uniform type is a sampler.

methods.name: get_is_matrix
methods.description: Checks if the uniform type is a matrix.

methods.name: get_is_image
methods.description: Checks if the uniform type is an image.

methods.name: get_glsl_asfloat
methods.description: Determines GLSL conversion string for the uniform type.
